reference_architecture.product: PinballCabinet.com Virtual Pinball Cabinet Rear CPU Slide Out Shelf
reference_architecture.lesson: rear access door plus one simple board on full-extension side-mount slides; adapt dimensions to owner PC case rather than copy the commercial dimensions

rear_service_door.architecture: dedicated rear main-cabinet backdoor immediately in front of the PC shelf
rear_service_door.latch: keyed or tool-controlled compression/quarter-turn latch; exact hardware TBD
rear_service_door.reinforcement: compact local rear-panel frame only; preserve broad rear-panel structure by using a narrower aperture than v0.23

pc_shelf.architecture: one narrow rectangular plywood board on two simple full-extension slides, extracted straight rearward through the backdoor
pc_shelf.orientation: rotate owner open case so 265 mm dimension is across cabinet and 440 mm dimension is fore-aft
pc_shelf.slide_pair: simple 450 mm-class 3-section full-extension side-mount ball-bearing slides
pc_shelf.stowed_retention_concept: single simple captive thumb screw, spring pin or equivalent positive stop accessible from rear door
pc_shelf.case_mounting: open PC case bolts directly to the shelf; no drawer box, no second sled, no lift-out requirement for routine service
pc_shelf.case_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual open PC case is purchased and measured
pc_shelf.slide_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual slide pair is purchased and measured
pc_shelf.cabling_policy: no dedicated modeled CPU harness; isolate power and unplug/dress ordinary PC cables as needed before full shelf extraction
pc_shelf.service_access: stand behind machine, isolate cabinet power, open rear door outward, release retainer, pull PC shelf rearward until the case is substantially outside cabinet
pc_shelf.complete_removal: disconnect ordinary PC cables as required, use slide disconnect feature if present, then remove board plus bolted case through rear opening
pc_shelf.rule: rear PC service is intentionally simple: outward-opening backdoor + narrow board + two slides + one retainer
